fact: The Ghana Statistical Service's own page reproduces the operative text of the Statistical Service Act (Act 1003) as the governing law; the page is undated, so the year is the Act's, 2019.
Ghana Statistical Service announced a stakeholder engagement with MDAs, development partners, civil society and academia on a proposed Statistics Ghana Bill, 2026.
This is the text of the Statistical Service Act, 2019 (Act 1003), assented to 24 September 2019 and commenced 27 September 2019.
The Global Partnership account says Ghana's statistics law gives Ghana Statistical Service a mandate to request administrative data.
MyJoyOnline reports Government Statistician Alhassan Iddrisu saying on 17 November 2026 that a draft Statistics Bill creating a Statistics Fund will go to Cabinet before Parliament.

The 2026 Data Forum urged all producers of official statistics to apply the confidentiality and data protection provisions of the Statistical Service Act, 2019 (Act 1003), which it treats as in force.
A draft Statistics Bill incorporating a new financing model and a proposed National Statistics Fund awaits approval, and the Data Forum urged GSS to expedite its submission to Cabinet and Parliament.
